answer: A walnut tally stops fakes: each newcomer splits a walnut stick into two halves, files one on the meadow registry, seals the other in a mirror vault. Each epoch the agent shows its half; auditors match the grain against the mirror half, and a mismatch burns the bond. First tally 44 credits, k-th 44+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes spend 2,541,500, tie up 60,000, for a 40,000 pool. Rented halves fail: one grain fits only its twin. A truthful agent pays 44.
